text: Setting project goals is essential for success. One effective method is using SMART goals, which are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. These goals help your team stay focused and know exactly what to accomplish. It is also important to define milestones, which are key points in the project timeline, and deliverables, the final products or results you must provide. Finally, stakeholder alignment matters. Make sure everyone involved understands and agrees on the goals from the start. When goals are clear and everyone is aligned, projects are more likely to finish on time and meet expectations.
